treatment_setting_evidence.quote: glioblastoma patients with newly or enlarged enhancing lesion within 3 months after completing 6 weeks of adjuvant chemoradiation therapy

coder_notes: Imaging phantom device study (P4 for DCE-MRI); no drug interventions registered. The 'pharmacokinetic parameter' in outcomes is a DCE-MRI perfusion parameter, not drug PK. Patients are post-chemoradiation with enlarging lesions (pseudo- vs true progression), so setting left unclear.
